Smart SE 730W Gold  The Thermaltake SMART SE series are power supply units (PSU) that incorporate various high-tech components, leading technology and Eco-friendly commendations, ranging between 530W to 730W with a semi-modular that will always accommodate any mainstream build under any circumstance. Embedded ultra-quiet fan delivers silent cooling with intelligent RPM control system. Single strong 12V rail flexibly routes the maximum available power to your CPU and graphic cards, offering maximized power usage and easy setup. Ultra-quiet Fan A large embedded ultra-quiet 140mm cooling fan that delivers an excellent airflow with an exceptionally low noise level and an intelligent RPM control system, which automatically detects the power load for fan speed adjustment and maintains an optimal silent operation. Outstanding Power Efficiency Delivering up to 90% efficiency at a 20%-70% capacity under real life loading world loading conditions to cut down on electric costs by saving on any unnecessary waste of energy to continually protect our environment, while supporting the criteria for the Energy Star 5.0 standard. Flat Modular Cables All new low-profile flat modular cables enhance the airflow as well as improve the thermal performance of the chassis. Moreover, flat cables are softer which make cable routing easier to install. Modular Cable The customizing concept of the Smart SE 530/630/730W enables users to maximize all the available power and making a stress-free setup.It is a semi-modular power supply that offers cable selection for users while powering the system at an advantageous voltage. High Quality Main Capacitor The high quality main capacitor produces an ultimate performance with low impedance characteristics. This stable operation works for a much longer time with excellent reliability to enhance the performance of the power supply. Massive and Dedicated Single +12V Output Smart SE Series Gold is equipped with a pure and powerful single +12V rail to provide the best compatibility for PC.

textSegments: Smart SE Series SPS-0730M - 730W Gold Semi Modular APFC PSU

The Thermaltake SMART SE series are power supply units (PSU) that incorporate various high-tech components, leading technology and Eco-friendly commendations, ranging between 530W to 730W with a semi-modular that will always accommodate any mainstream build under any circumstance. Embedded ultra-quiet fan delivers silent cooling with intelligent RPM control system. Single strong 12V rail flexibly routes the maximum available power to your CPU and graphic cards, offering maximized power usage and easy setup.

A large embedded ultra-quiet 140mm cooling fan that delivers an excellent airflow with an exceptionally low noise level and an intelligent RPM control system, which automatically detects the power load for fan speed adjustment and maintains an optimal silent operation.

Delivering up to 90% efficiency at a 20%-70% capacity under real life loading world loading conditions to cut down on electric costs by saving on any unnecessary waste of energy to continually protect our environment, while supporting the criteria for the Energy Star 5.0 standard.
All new low-profile flat modular cables enhance the airflow as well as improve the thermal performance of the chassis. Moreover, flat cables are softer which make cable routing easier to install.

The customizing concept of the Smart SE 530/630/730W enables users to maximize all the available power and making a stress-free setup.It is a semi-modular power supply that offers cable selection for users while powering the system at an advantageous voltage.

The high quality main capacitor produces an ultimate performance with low impedance characteristics. This stable operation works for a much longer time with excellent reliability to enhance the performance of the power supply.
Smart SE Series Gold is equipped with a pure and powerful single +12V rail to provide the best compatibility for PC.
16msec (minimum) at 80% of full load at 230Vac input.
